title: Treasury 30-Year Yields Are Back at 2007 Highs
summary: Global bond yields have resumed their march higher on Monday, with US rates pushing to pre-global financial crisis highs again. With oil ticking higher on fresh Middle East headlines and the Empire Manufacturing survey coming in hotter than expected, yields have extended their ascent in the US session. The emergence of weaker employment and inflation looked like it might have been enough to keep the long end of the curve at bay, but the balance of risks is shifting back toward higher rates. For more on the broader rate environment, we speak with Steven Major, Global Macro Advisor at Tradition. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Banks Cheer as Deregulation Agenda Spreads to Europe
summary:
The US has slashed red tape on Wall Street — now European banks want the same.

Chad Thomas explains why they're increasingly hopeful. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: America’s Critical Minerals Push Accelerates
summary: Nth Cycle CEO Megan O’Connor joins Bloomberg Open Interest to explain why China’s control of more than 85% of critical-mineral refining poses a major US supply-chain risk. She breaks down Washington’s push to keep battery materials at home, the government support needed to compete with China, and how Nth Cycle says its technology can bring domestic refining online faster. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Alibaba & Macy's Rise, Snap Shares Tumble | Stock Movers
summary:
On this episode of Stock Movers:

- Shares of Alibaba (BABA) rise after disclosing a deal to sell its gaming arm and touting claims of more than 3 billion downloads for its open AI model.

- Shares of DR Horton (DHI) and Macy’s (M) are moved higher after Berkshire Hathaway disclosed stakes in the companies in a filing. 

- Shares of Snap (SNAP) are down in trading Monday. The stock is set to end its win streak over past two sessions. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Latest Oil Market News and Analysis for June 17
summary: Oil swung between gains and losses in thin summer trading amid indications that shipments through the Strait of Hormuz are higher than industry observers expected, even as the war shows little sign of easing.

title: Some Bonds Are Getting 'Twitchy,' Steven Major Says
summary:
Steven Major, global macro advisor at Tradition Dubai, says some bonds may be getting "twitchy" further out on the curve. He says the US Treasury is not doing any favors for the taxpayer "by issuing long bonds north
north of 5% yield." He speaks on "Bloomberg Surveillance." (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Why Jane Street Lost $15 Billion in July
summary: Jane Street posted roughly $15 billion of losses in July, its first monthly loss in about a decade, due to its investment in Situational Awareness and wrong-way bets in Asian equity markets. Katherine Doherty reports on "Bloomberg Open Interest." (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Shein Is Said to Target Up to $27 Billion Valuation in HK IPO
summary: Fast-fashion retailer Shein Global Holdings Ltd. is targeting a valuation in the range of $26 billion to $27 billion in its initial public offering in Hong Kong, according to people familiar with the matter, a sharp drop from its peak value.

title: Blackstone, Blue Owl Private Credit Funds Offer More Bonds
summary: Two private credit funds are offering investment-grade bonds Monday, following a lull of such deals to start the third quarter.

title: Glencore Backed Radiant World With Warrants Deal in Late 2025
summary: Glencore Plc last year acquired warrants that would have given it a minority ownership stake in Radiant World, the iron ore trader under pressure amid concerns it provided falsified documents to banks, according to people familiar with the matter.

title: AstraZeneca Reports Mixed Lung Cancer Trial Results
summary: AstraZeneca is stopping a clinical trial of the experimental drug volrustomig as it didn’t look set to help fight lung cancer better than existing therapies. The company had two separate late-stage trial successes that strengthen key cancer franchises, including one where patients with non-small cell lung cancer received Tagrisso in combination with Orpathys. Bloomberg Intelligence's Sam Fazeli has more on "Bloomberg Open Interest." (Source: Bloomberg)

title: US Stocks Waver as Rising Oil Prices, Yields Offset Tech Gains
summary: US stocks faltered at the open on Monday as long-term Treasury yields extended their recent climb and oil ticked higher. Technology stocks notched gains as details of Anthropic’s surging sales growth stoked bullish sentiment around AI.

title: Saudis Offer Oil From Near Oman in Possible Sign of Shuttling
